sources.locator: "Spanish colonization of the Americas", revision 1376245871, § The crown and the indigenous populations

explanation: The other half of the same sentence: the more stringent laws of 1542 were promulgated **"following the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire and the Spanish conquest of Peru"** — the conquest of Peru being the campaign this atlas holds as the Spanish conquest of the Inca Empire, which the record's own article calls "also known as the Conquest of Peru". The article adds what happened when the laws met the conquest they answered: in Peru the viceroy's attempt to implement them "so soon after the conquest sparked a revolt by conquerors against the viceroy".
